title: Clock on the left
description: Reverses the header's grid order: the clock (time + date + refresh hint) sits on the left, route logo + stop name shift to the right, and the theme toggle stays in the far corner. Whole-arrangement swap, not a per-element restyle.
baseline_ref: app/pages/index.vue .screen__header (grid 1fr auto auto: route | clock | toggle)

changes.intent: Flip column sizing so the clock's auto-width column comes first and the route block takes the flexible remainder on the right.
Reorder the clock to the visual left without touching markup order.
Push route/stop block to the right and right-align its contents against the new flexible column.
Keep the toggle last, now visually in the same far-right corner as before.
